b6_reason: The Arrhenius equation in two-temperature form, log(k2/k1) = Ea(T2-T1)/(2.303*R*T1*T2), needs rate constants at two temperatures.
b6_working: ln(k2/k1) = -(Ea/R)(1/T2 - 1/T1); with k at a single temperature Ea cannot be separated from A, so two rate constants at two different temperatures are required.
